title: Grateful Dead Live at Memorial Union Ballroom, Purdue U. on 1969-04-18
lineage: SBD > MC > C > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of a 1969 show with good‑to‑excellent audio; the performance shines on the Cryptical > Other One sandwich, Lovelight and King Bee despite some mixed feelings about overall energy.
ai_review.review: Most fans rate this concert highly, highlighting the tight Cosmic Charlie/Other One sandwich, an epic Lovelight, and strong renditions of Hard to Handle, King Bee and Morning Dew. The soundboard source is generally clear with only a slight hiss, though one reviewer called it mediocre. A few listeners note sluggishness and flat bass, but the consensus leans positive.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is praised by the majority (4‑star+ comments) while recording quality is described as good to excellent; only one low rating drags the average down slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear soundboard capture with a little hiss; most reviewers find it listenable and often excellent, though one calls it mediocre.

standout_songs: Cosmic Charlie > Other One > Cosmic Charlie sandwich
Sitting On Top Of the World
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows well, especially the tight Cryptical‑Other One‑Cryptical sequence and the extended Lovelight. A power outage interrupted Hard to Handle early on but the band resumed without losing momentum.

band_member_comments.Phil: DanK notes Phil's bass was flat and sluggish during this show.
band_member_comments.Keys: Multiple reviewers praise Pigpen’s bluesy organ/vocals on King Bee, Hard to Handle and other songs.
